caption: Physical Site
description: Adds physical site context to event classes and objects. Apply this profile when the event is tied to a physical place: it carries the site identity and the in-site location (building, floor, security zone). Applying it to Identity & Access Management classes allows logical access events to be correlated with physical presence at the same site, and applying it to the location object gives any device or endpoint physical site context.
name: physical_site

site_uid.description: The unique identifier of the physical site where the activity occurred, as defined by the reporting organization.

site_name.description: The name of the physical site where the activity occurred.

building.description: The building within the physical site.

floor.description: The floor or level within the building.

security_zone.description: The physical security zone where the activity occurred.
